datasets.name: heatmap_atividade
queryLines:
SELECT
  DAYOFWEEK(event_time) AS dia_semana,
  HOUR(event_time) AS hora,
  COUNT(*) AS total,
  request_params.share AS share_name
FROM
  system.access.audit
WHERE
  action_name IN (
    'deltaSharingQueryTable', 'deltaSharingQueryTableChanges', 'generateTemporaryTableCredential'
  )
  AND event_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
GROUP BY
  dia_semana,
  hora,
  share_name
ORDER BY
  dia_semana,
  hora

datasets.name: tipo_conector
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN
      user_agent LIKE '%PowerBI%'
      OR user_agent LIKE '%powerbi%'
    THEN
      'PowerBI'
    WHEN
      user_agent LIKE '%pandas%'
      OR user_agent LIKE '%Pandas%'
    THEN
      'Pandas'
    WHEN
      user_agent LIKE '%Spark%'
      OR user_agent LIKE '%spark%'
    THEN
      'Spark'
    WHEN
      user_agent LIKE '%Python%'
      OR user_agent LIKE '%python%'
    THEN
      'Python'
    WHEN
      user_agent LIKE '%Tableau%'
      OR user_agent LIKE '%tableau%'
    THEN
      'Tableau'
    ELSE 'Outro'
  END AS conector,
  COUNT(*) AS total,
  request_params.share AS share_name
FROM
  system.access.audit
WHERE
  action_name IN (
    'deltaSharingQueryTable', 'deltaSharingQueryTableChanges', 'generateTemporaryTableCredential'
  )
  AND event_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
GROUP BY
  conector,
  share_name
ORDER BY
  total DESC

datasets.name: total_recipients
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_recipients
FROM

datasets.name: top_recipients_queries
queryLines:
SELECT
  request_params.recipient_name AS recipient,
  COUNT(*) AS total_queries,
  request_params.share AS share_name
FROM
  system.access.audit
WHERE
  action_name IN (
    'deltaSharingQueryTable', 'deltaSharingQueryTableChanges', 'generateTemporaryTableCredential'
  )
  AND event_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND request_params.recipient_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  recipient,
  share_name
ORDER BY
  total_queries DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: bytes_por_dia
queryLines:
SELECT
  DATE(event_time) AS dia,
  SUM(CAST(get_json_object(response.result, '$.scannedAddFileSize') AS BIGINT)) AS bytes_scanned,
  get_json_object(response.result, '$.deltaSharingShareName') AS share_name,
  get_json_object(response.result, '$.deltaSharingRecipientName') AS recipient_name,
  event_date
FROM
  system.access.audit
WHERE
  action_name = 'deltaSharingQueriedTable'
  AND event_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
GROUP BY
  dia,
  share_name,
  recipient_name,
  event_date
ORDER BY
  dia

datasets.name: share_recipient_map
queryLines:

datasets.name: top_tabelas
queryLines:
SELECT
  CONCAT(request_params.share, '.', request_params.schema, '.', request_params.name) AS tabela,
  COUNT(*) AS total_acessos,
  request_params.share AS share_name
FROM
  system.access.audit
WHERE
  action_name IN ('deltaSharingQueryTable', 'deltaSharingQueryTableChanges')
  AND event_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
GROUP BY
  tabela,
  share_name
ORDER BY
  total_acessos DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: token_status
queryLines:
SELECT
  r.recipient_name AS recipient,
  r.authentication_type AS tipo_autenticacao,
  r.created AS criado_em,
  rt.expiration_time AS expiracao_token,
  CASE
    WHEN rt.expiration_time IS NULL THEN 'Sem Token'
    WHEN rt.expiration_time < NOW() THEN '⚠️ Expirado'
    WHEN rt.expiration_time < NOW() + INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN '⚡ Expira em breve'
    ELSE '✅ Válido'
  END AS status
FROM
  system.information_schema.recipients r
    LEFT JOIN system.information_schema.recipient_tokens rt
      ON r.recipient_name = rt.recipient_name
ORDER BY
  rt.expiration_time ASC

datasets.name: egress_recipient
queryLines:
SELECT
  r.recipient_name AS recipient,
  r.recipient_name AS recipient_name,
  SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS total_egress,
  u.usage_date AS event_date
FROM
  system.billing.usage u
    JOIN system.information_schema.recipients r
      ON u.usage_metadata.recipient_id = r.recipient_id
WHERE
  u.billing_origin_product = 'NETWORKING'
  AND u.usage_metadata.associated_product = 'DATA_SHARING'
  AND u.usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
GROUP BY
  r.recipient_name,
  u.usage_date
ORDER BY
  total_egress DESC

datasets.name: filter_recipients
queryLines:
SELECT DISTINCT
  recipient_name
FROM
  system.information_schema.recipients
ORDER BY

datasets.name: dbus_materializacao
queryLines:
SELECT
  bu.usage_date AS dia,
  SUM(bu.usage_quantity) AS total_dbus,
  dm.share_name AS share_name,
  srp.recipient_name AS recipient_name,
  bu.usage_date AS event_date
FROM
  system.billing.usage bu
    INNER JOIN system.sharing.materialization_history dm
      ON dm.sharing_materialization_id = bu.usage_metadata.sharing_materialization_id
    LEFT JOIN system.information_schema.share_recipient_privileges srp
      ON srp.share_name = dm.share_name
WHERE
  bu.billing_origin_product = 'DATA_SHARING'
  AND bu.usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
GROUP BY
  dia,
  dm.share_name,
  srp.recipient_name,
  event_date
ORDER BY
  dia

datasets.name: ips_origem
queryLines:
SELECT
  request_params.recipient_name AS recipient,
  request_params.recipient_name AS recipient_name,
  CONCAT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(source_ip_address, '.', 2), '.***.**') AS ip_origem,
  COUNT(*) AS total_requests,
  MIN(event_time) AS primeiro_acesso,
  MAX(event_time) AS ultimo_acesso,
  request_params.share AS share_name,
  event_date
FROM
  system.access.audit
WHERE
  action_name IN (
    'deltaSharingQueryTable', 'deltaSharingQueryTableChanges', 'generateTemporaryTableCredential'
  )
  AND event_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  AND source_ip_address IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  request_params.recipient_name,
  CONCAT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(source_ip_address, '.', 2), '.***.**'),
  request_params.share,
  event_date
ORDER BY
  total_requests DESC

datasets.name: alteracoes_recentes
queryLines:
SELECT
  event_time AS data_hora,
  action_name AS acao,
  user_identity.email AS executado_por,
  COALESCE(
    request_params.name,
    request_params.share_name,
    request_params.recipient_name
  ) AS objeto_alterado,
  response.status_code AS status,
  CASE
    WHEN
      action_name IN ('createShare', 'updateShare', 'deleteShare')
    THEN
      COALESCE(request_params.share_name, request_params.name)
  END AS share_name,
  CASE
    WHEN
      action_name IN ('createRecipient', 'updateRecipient', 'deleteRecipient')
    THEN
      COALESCE(request_params.recipient_name, request_params.name)
  END AS recipient_name,
  event_date
FROM
  system.access.audit
WHERE
  action_name IN (
    'createShare',
    'updateShare',
    'deleteShare',
    'createRecipient',
    'updateRecipient',
    'deleteRecipient'
  )
  AND event_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
ORDER BY
  event_time DESC

datasets.name: acesso_negado
queryLines:
SELECT
  CONCAT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(source_ip_address, '.', 2), '.***.**') AS ip,
  request_params.recipient_name AS recipient,
  request_params.recipient_name AS recipient_name,
  action_name AS acao,
  COUNT(*) AS tentativas_negadas,
  MIN(event_time) AS primeira_tentativa,
  MAX(event_time) AS ultima_tentativa,
  request_params.share AS share_name,
  event_date
FROM
  system.access.audit
WHERE
  request_params.is_ip_access_denied = 'true'
  AND event_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
GROUP BY
  CONCAT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(source_ip_address, '.', 2), '.***.**'),
  request_params.recipient_name,
  action_name,
  request_params.share,
  event_date
ORDER BY
  tentativas_negadas DESC

datasets.name: custo_sharing_dia
queryLines:
SELECT
  bu.usage_date AS dia,
  bu.sku_name,
  SUM(bu.usage_quantity) AS total_dbus,
  ROUND(SUM(bu.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default), 2) AS custo_usd,
  bu.usage_date AS event_date
FROM
  system.billing.usage bu
    LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
      ON bu.sku_name = lp.sku_name
      AND lp.price_start_time <= bu.usage_start_time
      AND (
        lp.price_end_time IS NULL
        OR lp.price_end_time >= bu.usage_start_time
      )
      AND lp.currency_code = 'USD'
WHERE
  bu.billing_origin_product = 'DATA_SHARING'
  AND bu.usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
GROUP BY
  bu.usage_date,
  bu.sku_name
ORDER BY
  dia

datasets.name: custo_sharing_recipient
queryLines:
SELECT
  COALESCE(dm.share_name, 'N/A') AS share_name,
  COALESCE(srp.recipient_name, 'N/A') AS recipient_name,
  COALESCE(srp.recipient_name, 'N/A') AS recipient_name_filter,
  COALESCE(dm.share_name, 'N/A') AS share_name_filter,
  SUM(bu.usage_quantity) AS total_dbus,
  ROUND(SUM(bu.usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default), 2) AS custo_usd,
  bu.usage_date AS event_date
FROM
  system.billing.usage bu
    LEFT JOIN system.sharing.materialization_history dm
      ON dm.sharing_materialization_id = bu.usage_metadata.sharing_materialization_id
    LEFT JOIN system.information_schema.share_recipient_privileges srp
      ON srp.share_name = dm.share_name
    LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
      ON bu.sku_name = lp.sku_name
      AND lp.price_start_time <= bu.usage_start_time
      AND (
        lp.price_end_time IS NULL
        OR lp.price_end_time >= bu.usage_start_time
      )
      AND lp.currency_code = 'USD'
WHERE
  bu.billing_origin_product = 'DATA_SHARING'
  AND bu.usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
GROUP BY
  dm.share_name,
  srp.recipient_name,
  bu.usage_date
ORDER BY
  custo_usd DESC
